runs.text: The features of this Act were as follows:
establishment of a Reserve Bank of India
Jawaharlal Nehru as the first Prime Minister of independent India
Britain, France, Japan, China, Italy, Norway, Sweden
US, Switzerland, Australia, Canada, Russia, Brazil, Argentina
Chairman of Rajya Sabha or Speaker of Lok Sabha,
adjourned for more than four consecutive
all business including bills, motions, resolutions, notices, petitions and so on pending before it or its committees lapse
The Chairman is elected by the council itself from amongst its members.
Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act of 1971
